name: ABP 206
sort_evidence: ABP 206 is Amgen's proposed biosimilar to Opdivo (nivolumab) in a Phase 3 comparison in melanoma (NCT06054555, active not recruiting); the biosimilar itself is unapproved and not in the AMGN book (https://www.pearceip.law/2026/02/03/amgen-update-on-biosimilar-pipeline-nivolumab-ocrelizumab-pembrolizumab/).

trials.title: A Study to Evaluate ABP 206 Compared With OPDIVO® (Nivolumab) in Subjects With Unresectable or Metastatic Melanoma
